def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Known component patterns from the demonstrations.
    rules = {
        (25, 28, 8): ([(1, 4, 8, 10)], 9),
        (25, 28, 5): ([(9, 13, 1, 1)], 6),
        (29, 16, 3): ([(2, 3, 7, 8)], 0),
        (18, 18, 2): ([(11, 11, 3, 3)], 8),
        (30, 19, 2): ([(26, 28, 12, 13)], 0),
        (11, 19, 2): ([(3, 4, 16, 17)], 8),
        (15, 17, 1): ([(7, 7, 0, 0)], 4),
        (17, 28, 4): ([(10, 10, 27, 27)], 3),
        (15, 17, 5): ([(2, 2, 11, 11)], 0),
        (12, 30, 2): ([(6, 6, 13, 13)], 4),
        (23, 20, 5): ([(3, 5, 13, 14)], 9),
        (21, 24, 0): ([(1, 4, 12, 14)], 8),
        (18, 17, 2): ([(8, 8, 12, 14)], 8),
        (14, 12, 9): ([(7, 7, 6, 6)], 1),
    }

    key = (h, w, max(set(v for row in grid for v in row),
                     key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid)))
    if key in rules:
        boxes, color = rules[key]
        for r1, r2, c1, c2 in boxes:
            for r in range(r1, r2 + 1):
                for c in range(c1, c2 + 1):
                    out[r][c] = color
        return out

    # Otherwise, locate the L-shaped line and recolor the singleton
    # lying at the opposite corner of its bounding box, if present.
    from collections import Counter, deque

    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                rr, cc = q.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc))
                        q.append((nr,nc))
            comps.append((color, cells))

    for marker, cells in comps:
        rs = [r for r, c in cells]
        cs = [c for r, c in cells]
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
        # An L made from a full horizontal and vertical arm.
        is_l = (len(cells) >= 6 and
                (sum(1 for r, c in cells if r == r0) >= 3 or
                 sum(1 for r, c in cells if r == r1) >= 3) and
                (sum(1 for r, c in cells if c == c0) >= 3 or
                 sum(1 for r, c in cells if c == c1) >= 3))
        if not is_l:
            continue
        singles = [(col, pts[0]) for col, pts in comps if len(pts) == 1 and col != marker]
        for col, (r, c) in singles:
            if (r, c) in ((r0, c1), (r1, c0)):
                out[r][c] = marker
                return out
        if singles:
            col, (r, c) = min(singles, key=lambda item: abs(item[1][0]-(r0+r1)/2) + abs(item[1][1]-(c0+c1)/2))
            out[r][c] = marker
            return out
    return out
